functions.name: AddAzureConnectorNamespace
functions.description: Adds an Azure Connector Namespace resource to the application model.
functions.remarks:
Connector Namespace is a preview service. Connections that use OAuth or another interactive
authorization flow must be authorized in the Connector Namespaces portal after provisioning.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the resource.

functions.name: AddConnection
functions.description: Adds a connection to an Azure Connector Namespace.
functions.remarks:
This method provisions the connection resource but does not automate OAuth consent or other
interactive authorization. Complete those steps in the Connector Namespaces portal.
functions.signature: AddConnection(name string, connectorName string, options ...*AzureConnectorNamespaceConnectionOptions) AzureConnectorNamespaceConnectionResource

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Aspire resource name.

parameters.name: connectorName
parameters.description: The connector catalog name, such as `office365`.

functions.name: AddMcpServerConfig
functions.description: Adds a managed MCP server configuration to an Azure Connector Namespace.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Aspire resource name.

functions.name: AsExisting
functions.description: Marks a Connector Namespace connection as an existing Azure resource.

functions.name: AsExisting
functions.description: Marks a managed MCP server configuration as an existing Azure resource.

functions.name: WithAccessPolicy
functions.description: Adds a Microsoft Entra access policy to a Connector Namespace connection.
functions.remarks:
Access policies authorize a specific Microsoft Entra principal to use the connection. They do
not perform connector OAuth consent and should be limited to principals that require access.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Aspire resource name for the policy.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The authorized principal and optional Azure policy name.

functions.name: WithAccessPolicy
functions.description: Adds a Microsoft Entra user or group access policy to a managed MCP server configuration.
functions.remarks:
Managed MCP endpoints reject callers that do not have a config-scoped access policy.
Connector Namespace currently supports Microsoft Entra users and groups for these policies.
The Azure child resource name is set to the principal object ID as required by the service.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Aspire resource name for the policy.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The authorized user or group.

functions.name: WithConnector
functions.description: Adds a connector route and an explicit operation allow-list to a managed MCP server configuration.
functions.remarks:
Connections and MCP server configurations are separate Azure resources so a connection can be
reused independently. This method links the MCP server configuration to its underlying connection
and exposes only the operations listed in `options` as MCP tools. Operation IDs
are connector-specific and should be verified against the connector operation metadata. The current
Connector Namespace preview supports one connector per managed MCP server configuration.

parameters.name: connectorName
parameters.description: The connector route name.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: The connection used by the connector route.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The connector metadata and operation allow-list.

functions.name: WithIdentityAccessPolicy
functions.description: Adds a connection access policy for a user-assigned managed identity.
functions.remarks:
This method authorizes the identity to use the connection. The connection's downstream OAuth,
API key, or basic authentication must still be configured separately.
functions.signature: WithIdentityAccessPolicy(name string, identity AzureUserAssignedIdentityResource, options ...*WithIdentityAccessPolicyOptions) AzureConnectorNamespaceConnectionResource

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The Aspire resource name for the policy.

parameters.name: identity
parameters.description: The user-assigned managed identity authorized to use the connection.

fields.name: PolicyName
fields.description: The optional Azure child resource name. The Aspire resource name is used when omitted.
